step_metric: Maximum across ranks of mean step time; then mean and sample standard deviation across three independent runs.
sync_metric: Maximum across ranks of mean synchronization time; then mean across three independent runs.
limitations: CPU/Gloo toy model; not the required two-GPU XL experiment.
No per-step samples were saved; reported standard deviation is across three run-level aggregates.
Fixed alternating order, not randomized; concurrent host load was not controlled.
Synchronization includes packing, all-reduce, averaging, copying back, and possible rank waiting where applicable.
